usedFor: SimpleCert holds certificates and recipients, HubSpot holds contacts and deals, and “New Recipient Added” can start “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Recipient Added” in SimpleCert, then “Create Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: It creates a HubSpot contact from the recipient, with email as the required field.

watchOut: All three SimpleCert triggers are polling, so “Create Deal” in HubSpot starts after a short delay.
